identityTest.stableIdentity: A governed test environment remains identifiable across test runs and subject releases while its reproducible configuration and baseline evolve through controlled revisions.
identityTest.versionIdentity: Changes to runtime topology, services, dependencies, data fixtures, configuration, tooling or isolation controls create immutable environment-baseline versions.

Tested build, release or artifact identity

excludes: test specification, run, observation, verdict or evidence identity
defect, requirement, task, build or release identity

access authorization beyond environment policy binding

invariants: Environment identity remains separate from production deployment and runtime identity.
Configuration, dependency, fixture, toolchain or isolation changes create a new immutable baseline.
A test environment never owns test specification, run, verdict, defect or release identity.
Environment qualification is scoped to declared test classes and never proves product quality.
Environment failure is an attributable adjudication supported by environment evidence.
A zero exit code, empty failure list or absence of defects never implies a passed test.
Flaky classification requires an attempt set with identical definition, parameters, subject digest and relevant environment baseline.
Environment degradation never silently rewrites prior run results.
Fixture limitations and representativeness remain explicit in every affected run.
Access, isolation and reset controls are versioned and auditable.
Retired baselines remain resolvable for historical evidence and rerun analysis.
Until identity grain is resolved, TestRun carries an immutable EnvironmentPin value and no mastered Test Environment reference is required.
Fixture bindings declare synthetic, anonymised or production-derived origin; production-derived personal data requires basis and retention class.
holds: No registry namespace, identifier, parent or NEW MODEL decision is assigned.
Research material is not a specification or package-promotion claim.
Canonical publication and live verification are held.
decisionDeferredReason: Identity grain: snapshot digest or named pool plus as-of is unresolved.
Mutable baseline versus immutable snapshot and recalibration is unresolved.
Environment-failure attachment to run, environment or both is unresolved.
Shared fixtures versus ephemeral runner mastership is unresolved.
